Definition: something to capture with, i.e. a noose
BiblicalUsage: leked means something to capture with, and once is enough to see what it is doing. In Proverbs 3:26, "and shall keep thy foot from being taken.".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps my foot from the snare — the noose is set, but the Lord is my confidence, and He does not let it close.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
